name: lan-viet-shop
description: Website bán hoa lan - React (Vite) + react-router + Axios, API ASP.NET Core + EF Core + SQL Server, áp dụng các quy tắc bảo mật môn An toàn ứng dụng web và CSDL

scripts.setup: npm install && dotnet tool restore && npm run db:update
scripts.db:migration: dotnet ef migrations add --project backend/LanViet.Api -o Data/Migrations
scripts.start: vite build && dotnet run --project backend/LanViet.Api -c Release --launch-profile production
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev && dotnet list backend/LanViet.Api package --vulnerable --include-transitive
